text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-4821 for service=runtime-latency-alerts (severity=3).
incident-bot: Trigger: p95 latency > 600ms for 3/5 nodes in us-west-2 for 2m. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-4821

sara: acked via PD. jumping in — looking at dashboards now.

pagerduty: PD-4821 acknowledged by sara.

sara: quick check — any deployments in last 10m? @ben @jordan

ben: not from my side. CI deploys show none.

jordan: I see a small KV-cache warmup on the routing tier, likely from a traffic shift. p95 tokens spiked but error rate is flat. grabbing prometheus queries.

jordan: prometheus query: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le,instance))`
```
# sample output (scrubbed)
instance=pool-03-usw2 p95=720ms
instance=pool-01-usw2 p95=180ms
instance=pool-02-usw2 p95=650ms
```

ben: looks like pool-03 had a hot restart and its kv-cache got cold. I'm seeing a brief burst of cold-starts: `redis_miss_rate` up ~ 12%.

sara: sounds like a transient warmup not a full outage. Any customer-facing errors?

jordan: application error rate (5xx) is stable at 0.02% — no visible customer retries in SLO dashboards.

monitoring-bot: Alert auto-resolve scheduled: PD-4821 will auto-resolve if p95 < 600ms for 2m.

sara: ok, I'm going to keep the page open and watch for 5m. If it resolves, we close and annotate. If it persists, we'll escalate to infra.

ben: I've pushed a small KV pre-warm to pool-03 (one-off). command: `infractl kv prewarm --pool pool-03 --duration 60s`

jordan: logs show connection churn during the window; looks correlated with a client-side traffic reshuffle (CDN edge).

incident-bot: PD-4821 condition cleared (p95 < 600ms for 2m). Auto-resolving alert.

pagerduty: PD-4821 resolved. Resolved by monitoring-bot.

sara: cool — no action needed beyond pre-warm. No customer impact. marking as "transient/noisy".

ben: adding a short runbook note: if pool p95 stays >600ms and redis_miss_rate >10% for >3m, manual pre-warm and escalate to infra.

jordan: filing a quick follow-up ticket to add a cooldown in routing to avoid churn spikes. ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RW-6291

sara: thanks. handing off to monitoring rotation. I'm back on-call in 10. :thumbsup:

sara: thread summary -> PD-4821: transient p95 spike due to KV-cache warmup on pool-03, auto-resolved, no 5xx customer impact, pre-warm applied, follow-up ticket RW-6291.

ben: adding tags: #auto-resolved #kv-warmup #no-customer-impact

jordan: re-run of dashboards in 30m to confirm stability.

monitoring-bot: NOTE: suppressed duplicate alerts for same condition in 15m window.

sara: closing thread. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
